study type: longitudinal prospective multicenter observational cohort study
cohort: Healthy women with no comorbidities and singleton viable pregnancies undergoing first trimester prenatal screening were recruited from multiple centers.
finding: The SIMPLE nutritional score was significantly associated with first trimester PAPP-a concentrations and emergency cesarean section rates, while first trimester hemoglobin concentrations were associated with birth and placental weights.
mod_finding: The SIMPLE score subgroup was significantly associated with emergency cesarean section rates.
